actor_must: consume the externally issued challenge after contract commitment
create a new isolated branch from the triggering commit
write a challenge-bound canonical observation to a dedicated path
read back the file from the provider
read back the resulting commit from the provider
emit provider locators without assigning its own evidence class
credit: behavior-contract satisfaction only; no economic credit; no MICGI admission
witness_must: use a read path separate from the actor execution token
fetch workflow run and job state from the provider
fetch the response file by immutable commit SHA
fetch the response commit by immutable commit SHA
verify both observations bind the exact fresh challenge
issue the admission verdict; actor claims have zero admission authority
